									<h3 class="reviews-slider__title">Stacey G.</h3>
				
									<div class="reviews-slider__desc"><p><strong>Customer Loyalty Manager</strong><br />
Mid-Market (51-1000 emp.)</p>
</div>

					<div class="reviews-slider__review"><p>It has been a game-changer for my agency. With Expandi, I was able to simplify the setup and management process with new roles and permissions, which has been a huge relief for me. One of the best features of Expandi is its ability to work with a team and monitor campaign performance. This feature has made it easy for me to manage my team and track progress, saving me a lot of time. The integration with our CRM has been particularly helpful too. The history feature of Expandi has also been beneficial in helping me keep track of the progress of our campaigns. Overall, Expandi offers a variety of useful features at a good price, making it the best platform I’ve tried so far.</p>
</div>

									<h3 class="reviews-slider__title">Andrew K.</h3>
				
									<div class="reviews-slider__desc"><p><strong>Head of SDR</strong><br />
Mid-Market (51-1000 emp.)</p>
</div>
							</div>

					<div class="reviews-slider__review"><p>As a SDR team lead, I was on the hunt for a linkedin automation tool to assist with our outbound efforts. After testing multiple solutions, Expandi quickly stood out as the best option. Not only did it prove to be more effective than the other tools we tested, but it also provided additional value for our Product marketing team. We were able to A/B test messaging and positioning to update our buyer persona. As a B2B company, advertising can be costly, but Expandi proved to be a cost-effective solution that not only helped with sales but also with our product management and marketing goals.</p>
</div>

									<h3 class="reviews-slider__title">Aleksandra K.</h3>
				
									<div class="reviews-slider__desc"><p><strong>Public Relations Manager</strong><br />
Mid-Market (51-1000 emp.)</p>
</div>

					<div class="reviews-slider__review"><p>I’ve been thoroughly impressed with this LinkedIn automation tool’s ability to personalize and automate sequences for outreach prospecting. The possibility of sending automated outreach event invitations to targeted audiences has streamlined our attendance and engagement rates which is obviously great. Expandi is a nice tool for its price for outreach efforts because of the many features they offer, relatively easy setup process, and communication. We significantly increased our reply rates more efficiently as we didn’t have to spend lots of time on routine and monotone work. I am satisfied with the product and can recommend Expandi as a great outreach tool.</p>

<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During your free trial, you can try all the Expandi campaign types, search opportunities for audience scraping, filters, analytics, personalization, blacklist feature, and many other opportunities, and create as many campaigns as possible.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We suggest starting with baby steps, though. When it comes to limit ranges and the overall number of actions you can take during this week, you should warm up your account and ensure account safety first.</span></p>

														<div class="single-accordion__item">

										<span class="single-accordion__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
																					<p class="single-accordion__text has-xx-small-font-size">Can I change my plan or the number of seats later?</p>

																					<p class="single-accordion__text has-xx-small-font-size">Can I get a demo of Expandi? </p>

								</p>

										<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re considering adding more than 10 seats, our sales team can guide you through the platform and share valuable outreach strategies. <a href="https://expandi.io/demo-request" data-wpel-link="internal">Request a call right now</a></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></p>

										<span class="single-accordion__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
																					<p class="single-accordion__text has-xx-small-font-size">What pricing options does Expandi offer?</p>

								</p>
								<div id="body-block_f3043d29be1f67854ce9bd07fd3b17c8-5" class="single-accordion__content" aria-labelledby="heading-block_f3043d29be1f67854ce9bd07fd3b17c8-5">
									<div class="single-accordion__body">
										<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Expandi offers both a monthly plan for $99 and an annual one, including all features (additional taxes may vary by country). </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Choosing the annual plan and paying upfront grants you a 20% discount, equivalent to receiving two months for free. The more seats you acquire, the greater your potential discounts.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;"> If you’re evaluating Expandi for 10+ teams or seeking a white-label solution, <a href="https://expandi.io/demo" data-wpel-link="internal">please request a call</a></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">, and we’ll be delighted to assist you.</span></p>

									<div class="single-accordion__body">

									<div class="single-accordion__body">
										<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Being an ambassador grants you a unique chance to generate income by advocating for Expandi within your network. It offers an excellent means to share the Expandi message and receive recognition for your endeavors. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Moreover, our Affiliate Program imposes no costs on you. Creating an affiliate account is a swift process, and you can commence earning a 20% commission on each new customer you refer, which is applicable for 12 months from their registration date. What’s even more exciting? Your commission grows as you bring in more referrals! Learn more about our </span><a href="https://expandi.io/ambassador-partner/" data-wpel-link="internal"><span style="font-weight: 400;">affiliate program</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></p>
									</div>

									<div class="single-accordion__body">

																					<p class="single-accordion__text has-xx-small-font-size">What differentiates Expandi from other LinkedIn automation tools?</p>
																			</button>
								</p>

									<div class="single-accordion__body">
										<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Expandi offers a broader array of campaign types, allowing you to customize your outreach to align with your specific goals. Our cloud-based platform provides enhanced campaign capabilities that significantly boost the long-term efficiency of your outreach efforts. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We prioritize account safety by recommending the optimal number of weekly connections based on extensive research and thorough big data analysis, ensuring the protection and trustworthiness of your accounts. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">While promising high limits might be simple, we genuinely care about the long-term well-being of your accounts, providing our customers with top-notch practices and insights.</span></p>
